Temporary metrics parser packages are pinned and installed only at /tmp/pisharp-refactor-metrics-deps; no tracked dependency changes.
reproducibility.dotnet: Explicit package versions in csproj, net10.0; no packages.lock.json/global.json. SDK version 10.0.112 captured; transitive dependencies rely on NuGet restore. No new lockfiles introduced.
